sections.text: Danielle Brown was discharged twice by Newcastle Hospitals NHS Trust despite suffering from pre-eclampsia. Doctors later discovered her unborn baby, Maisie, had died. sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Simon Blake has called on the government to monitor the ruling's impact and address any harms. Stonewall is not seeking to overturn the ruling but is exploring how to ensure trans people remain protected under the law.

sections.text: The British children’s minister, Josh MacAlister, visited Denmark to inspect its children’s homes as part of a Department for Education review. sections.heading: What happens next
